My iPhone 15 screen won't turn sideways when I tilt it. I want it to rotate so I can watch videos. What do I do?

Here is how to let your iPhone screen rotate again.
1. Swipe down from the top-right corner of your screen to open Control Center.
2. Tap the **Portrait Orientation Lock** button and confirm it is off.
3. Close Control Center.
4. Turn the iPhone sideways.
Some apps don't support rotation, so your screen might not rotate even if Portrait Orientation Lock isn't turned on. If you don't see the **Portrait Orientation Lock** button, learn how to access more controls in Control Center.
